selection_algorithm: match task_class + workflow_tier + risk_keywords → return first matching pipeline_id

pipelines.description: Docs housekeeping: routing, cleaning, governance updates, docs refresh

role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Identify target files, route correctly to docs/, verify no root markdown created
role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT: Final gate check: confirm scope, confirm commit type

pipelines.description: Read-only health checks: compile, import, git state

role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT: Verify HEAD matches expected state; check active question
role_responsibilities.28_RUNTIME_OPERATIONS_AGENT: Run compile + import checks; assess runtime readiness
role_responsibilities.27_VERIFICATION_OFFICER_AGENT: Challenge any Grade E claims; enforce evidence minimum
role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Write final report to docs/reports/; update state/queue/memory

pipelines.description: Structural refactors: proxy/shim extraction, static utility migration, display proxy removal

role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT (pre): Confirm gate PROCEED; verify active question does not block; confirm forbidden scope list
role_responsibilities.02_CODE_ARCHITECT_AGENT: Implement extraction: move methods, update call sites, add proxies/shims
role_responsibilities.27_VERIFICATION_OFFICER_AGENT: Verify compile + tests + forbidden grep; challenge any Grade E claims
role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Write reports to docs/reports/; update state/queue/memory; verify root clean

allowed_actions: commit TYPE A then TYPE C
pipelines.full_accept_policy: auto — Grade C evidence sufficient; Grade A for GATE tier

pipelines.description: Post-commit paper run validation with JSONL field verification

role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT: Verify HEAD; confirm working tree clean; confirm no live trading risk
role_responsibilities.28_RUNTIME_OPERATIONS_AGENT: Launch paper run (timeout 420s); monitor cycles and exit code
role_responsibilities.11_OBSERVABILITY_INCIDENT_AGENT: Scan JSONL event stream; verify field shapes unchanged from pre-commit baseline
role_responsibilities.27_VERIFICATION_OFFICER_AGENT: Verify no AttributeError, no Traceback, STATUS NO LIVE ORDERS
role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Write validation report to docs/reports/; update state/queue/memory

pipelines.full_accept_policy: auto — Grade A evidence with paper run

pipelines.description: Gate checks and design documents for refactor batches

role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT: Gate check: audit candidate methods, check coupling, assign safe extraction scores, produce PROCEED/STOP verdict
role_responsibilities.02_CODE_ARCHITECT_AGENT: Design document: specify exact files, call sites, proxy strategy, test compatibility
role_responsibilities.27_VERIFICATION_OFFICER_AGENT: Design review: challenge assumptions, check forbidden scope, verify blast radius assessment
role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Write gate check to docs/audits/, design to docs/reports/; update state/queue/memory

forbidden_actions: start implementation before design is approved
pipelines.full_accept_policy: auto for gate check — design requires user approval before implementation

pipelines.description: Live trading, execution, risk, sizing, wallet, reconciliation, deployment, data deletion — always stops for human

role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT: Detect risk trigger; produce STOP report explaining why user approval is required; suggest safe next step

stop_conditions: ALWAYS — this pipeline always terminates at STOP_AND_REQUEST_USER_APPROVAL
pipelines.full_accept_policy: NEVER auto — user must explicitly authorize every Class 8 action

pipelines.description: Repository inventory, documentation map refresh, root cleanup, file routing

role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Inventory files; classify by type; route to correct docs/ subdirectory
role_responsibilities.02_CODE_ARCHITECT_AGENT: Review architectural implications of any structural changes
role_responsibilities.27_VERIFICATION_OFFICER_AGENT: Verify no incorrect file routing; check evidence grade

pipelines.description: Tool registry/pipeline spec updates and offline tooling tasks (Class 3 governance docs, Class 4 offline automation scripts)

role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT: Review tool definitions for safety; ensure full_accept_allowed=false for high-risk tools
role_responsibilities.27_VERIFICATION_OFFICER_AGENT: Verify tool schema completeness; check evidence grades match tier requirements
role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Write specs to docs/operations/; update state/queue/memory

forbidden_actions: modify TOOL_REGISTRY to add live trading tools

pipelines.description: AI Cognition Memory schema updates, pre-seeded safety entries, memory record writes

role_responsibilities.29_ARCHITECTURE_GOVERNANCE_AGENT: Approve new memory entries; ensure quant_safety entries have expires=NEVER
role_responsibilities.24_REPOSITORY_LIBRARIAN_AGENT: Write memory records to docs/operations/cognition_memory/; update schema
role_responsibilities.27_VERIFICATION_OFFICER_AGENT: Verify no raw logs in memory; verify evidence grade matches source

forbidden_actions: store raw paper run logs in memory

pipeline_selection_algorithm.step_1: Check for high-risk triggers → if found → HIGH_RISK_STOP_WORKFLOW
pipeline_selection_algorithm.step_2: Match task_class and workflow_tier to pipeline
pipeline_selection_algorithm.step_3: If multiple matches → select by risk_level (NONE first, then LOW, MEDIUM, CRITICAL)
pipeline_selection_algorithm.step_4: Read required_memory_reads before executing first role
pipeline_selection_algorithm.step_5: Execute role_sequence in order; each role reads only its declared inputs
pipeline_selection_algorithm.step_6: Run required_tools after EXECUTE state per tool pipeline spec
pipeline_selection_algorithm.step_7: Write memory entries per cognition memory schema after COMMIT
